nodes.description: fallback() external payable; accepts arbitrary calldata and value, deploys raw bytes as contract code via inline assembly create2.
address addr; receives the deployed contract address returned by the create2 opcode.
bytes memory code = msg.data; holds the caller-supplied bytecode copied from calldata and used as init code.
assembly create2(callvalue(), add(code, 32), mload(code), 0): deploys attacker-controlled bytecode unconditionally with no access control or salt validation.

edges.reason: The public payable fallback executes the create2 deployment for any caller without any owner/role check or validation, allowing arbitrary code deployment by anyone.
The user-controlled calldata buffer 'code' (msg.data) is passed directly as the init code pointer and length to the create2 opcode.
The address returned by the create2 opcode is assigned to the local variable 'addr' and then emitted.

normalization_plan.reason: 'addr' exists only to hold the result of the create2 opcode, so it is fully absorbed by the create2 unsafe operation node.
'code' is a pure copy of msg.data used solely as the init code input to create2, so it is absorbed by the create2 unsafe operation node.
